name: YouTube
title: youtube.com
shortDescription: YouTube is a global platform for video sharing and streaming, catering to a wide range of audiences including individuals, businesses, and creators. Users can upload, view, and share videos. An example use case is a content creator uploading educational videos to reach a broad audience and monetize their content through ad revenue.
